title: Custom Transportation Semi Truck on Geometric Background Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom with the unique trucker-themed bedding set from Jeminise, designed specifically for truck lovers and legends of the road. This custom comforter set features a modern digital graphic illustration of a semi truck on a geometric background with neon lines, offering a sleek, stylish alternative to traditional bedding. Made from soft and durable polyester, this comfortable bedding is perfect as a thoughtful gift for family and friends, allowing you to add a personalized name to make it truly one of a kind.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features a custom text input allowing you to personalize the bedding set with a custom name of your choice.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting, providing a lightweight, soft, and breathable sleeping experience.
  • Vibrant Trucker Theme: Decorated with a vibrant digital illustration of a semi truck, shipping containers, and neon geometric patterns that resist fading thanks to advanced eco-friendly printing techniques.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in standard US bedding sizes including Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88").
  • Flexible Components: Includes one comforter (or duvet cover) and option to add matching pillowcases or a flat sheet cover to complete your bedroom decor.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; air dry or tumble dry on low heat to maintain fluffiness and durability.

Product Specifications

Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber

Style Modern
Theme Trucker
Seasons All
